name: not-applicable-panes
summary: A pane the repository has no files for is recorded as not-applicable and left off the report entirely, so a report on a repository with no migrations says nothing about migrations. Panes the repository has but the change did not touch are still listed.
why_this_fixture_exists: The change is about what a report must not say. It is a good test of whether the reviewer can tell a deliberate silence from a missing case.

quiet.about: arguing the hidden panes should be shown
quiet.note: Hiding a pane the repository has no files for is the point of the change, argued in the diff's own comments. A reviewer that relitigates it has not read them.
